action: The eagle hugs a golden trophy cup to its chest with both wings wrapped around it, beams happily, then stretches both wings straight up and lifts the trophy high over its head, wing tips holding each side of the cup, holds it steady and proud, then brings it back down and settles. The trophy is a large, clearly visible golden cup with two handles, about as big as the eagle's head. The eagle's feathers, face and beak keep their normal colors the whole time with no glow, no aura and no light effects on the eagle; only the trophy shines. The branch and feet never move.
